purpose: Account-level TOTP status, enrollment, verification, one-time recovery-code reveal, regeneration and disable confirmation, accompanied by setup and recovery guidance.
primaryGoal: Enable or manage the current account's second factor and safely save recovery codes without changing authentication, step-up, impersonation or credential boundaries.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Per-user backend TOTP handler; current-account source, not vehicle or date-window data.
dataSources.behavior: Shared ['totp','status'] query observed by page and enrollment flow; signal forwarded; staleTime 30000; window-focus refetch disabled; AUTH_MODE_OPEN maps to the explicit open-mode union.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Backend per-user credential lifecycle; local flow holds returned secret and codes in component state, not persistent browser storage.
dataSources.behavior: Successful mutations invalidate and broadcast the status key; verification errors distinguish wrong code, rate limiting and expired enrollment. Regeneration and revoke are RequireSudo-gated in router source; entire subtree blocks impersonation.
dataSources.runtime: unverified; no mutation or credential action executed

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing request interceptor / reauthentication integration, not directly invoked by this page.
dataSources.behavior: Hook source caches the sudo token in memory with expiry validation. Interceptor and reauthentication UI were not traced beyond the page-specific hook.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Settings feature; four setup steps, six app brands and three recovery tips are authored guidance, not backend measurements.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Summary and hero independently derive last-used presentation. Hero trims blank timestamps, while summary only checks truthiness. A whitespace timestamp can produce inconsistent labels.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep both user-visible summary/detail occurrences; share a small feature-local timestamp normalization helper and current useDateFormat rather than duplicate formatters or remove a section.

Setup/app lists have useId heading associations; recovery panel is a named region.
Shared Input supplies label/control association; numeric code sanitization and Enter submission retained.
Open-mode guidance is role=status; initial enrollment skeleton has role=status, aria-busy and hidden loading text.

issues.detail: Verification error renders as a separate ErrorText at line 92, but Input receives neither error nor aria-describedby/aria-invalid. Shared Input already creates associated error feedback when its error prop is used.
issues.fix: Use the existing Input error contract or an explicit stable error ID plus aria-describedby and aria-invalid, preserving localized error branches and existing test selectors without duplicate announcements.

states.initialFailure: Enrollment has a source-local QueryError with refetch; summary marks source unavailable. Page supplies query metadata but does not globally replace neighboring content.

states.notEnrolled: Localized status and Enable TOTP action.

issues.detail: Initial branch tests isLoading rather than derived initial status. A no-data paused query has isLoading=false and no fatalError, reaching the !status.data open-mode branch at line 75 and incorrectly instructing a reverse-proxy configuration change.
issues.fix: Render initial/paused/unknown source guidance distinctly; render TotpOpenModeNotice only for an explicit mode=open response. Keep retained data on refresh failures.

issues.rule: MDC-024/MDC-046; preservation of one-time recovery reveal
issues.detail: Cancel button is disabled during verification, but Modal still receives unrestricted onClose. Shared title-close, backdrop and Escape paths can call closeDialog, which clears enrollment/codes while handleVerify remains pending. Its later success can reopen the backup dialog after dismissal. A subsequent enrollment before that result also risks old-flow presentation.
issues.fix: Guard all modal dismissal paths while verifying at the feature owner, or explicitly correlate pending completions with their flow generation. Preserve one-time code recovery and cleanup without changing credential endpoints or weakening sudo gates.
issues.runtime: pending-verification dismissal race not exercised; no credential mutation performed

states.runtime: All scenarios unverified; source inspection only

visualIssues.detail: Static companion panels use unrelated purple/cyan/amber IconBox tints and fixed cyan/emerald-300 list icons, adding decorative multi-hue emphasis. IconBox applies neonColorMap background/ring classes; contrast cannot be established from source.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer existing neutral surface/text tokens for informational headers/list icons; reserve semantic hue for active/warning/destructive credential state. Existing IconBox className is an available composition point; do not introduce a new palette. Preserve the white QR backing for scanner contrast rather than mechanically tokenizing it.
visualIssues.runtime: visual intensity and effective theme contrast unverified

priority.rationale: Existing shared architecture and decomposed feature surfaces should be retained. Address associated verification feedback, initial-paused trust labeling and asynchronous dismissal behavior before cosmetic modernization.

notes: No competing modal, query store, palette engine or enrollment renderer confirmed within inspected page-specific source.
Two status observers reuse the same query key; this is not evidence of duplicate independent backend sources.
Feature-local timestamp normalization is preferable to a new shared date-format engine.
Existing Input and feature-side guarded callbacks suffice for identified gaps; no shared API addition is required by this audit.

dataBehavior: Preserve all union states, snake_case payload fields, known-number handling and query policies.
Preserve local secret/code cleanup, one-time reveal, error branches, status invalidation/broadcast and request cancellation.
Do not persist tokens, secrets or backup codes in browser storage, report contents or logs.
Preserve subject ownership, open-mode unavailability, impersonation block and RequireSudo route guards.
No physical measurements or unit conversion are present in this flow; keep count dimensionless and timestamps formatted through existing locale/time preferences.

Do not invent vehicle/date scoping: /account prefix disables workspace vehicle control; /account/2fa is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS. Last verification is a recorded account event, not a date-window aggregate.
Retain all guidance and account controls on mobile; no lossy simplification.
